text:
alex_cs: Quick sync — new customer LuminaLabs onboarding today. They want a "bare-min" field kit for their engineers + a short, non-technical one-pager for PMs that covers caching, batching, and streaming. Goal: reduce first-week renewal risk.

maria_csm: I'll write the one-pager. Can we include three labeled profiles: conservative, standard, aggressive, with concrete numbers they can copy? PMs like that.

owen_sre: Yep. I'll produce the infra copy. My recommended defaults (engineer-facing):
- Cache: prefix + LRU, kv_store=128MB, ttl_seconds: conservative=45, standard=150, aggressive=600.
- Batching: adaptive enabled; max_batch_gpu=48, max_batch_cpu=6, target_batch_ms=15 (gpu) / 50 (cpu).
- Streaming: chunk_tokens=128, stream_window_ms=80, max_streams=12.

owen_sre: Also add: enable warm pools for the first 48h, prefill the top-100 prompt keys, and set fallback_route: nearest-compatible-model when p95 exceeds 350ms.

tara_support: For PM copy, translate: conservative = "low latency first, fewer multiplexed requests"; standard = "balanced cost/latency"; aggressive = "high throughput, best for predictable prompts and warmed caches". Call out tradeoffs. :balance_scale:

alex_cs: Include an operational checklist with owners and timing: Day0 owner=Support (smoke), Day1 owner=CS (priming), Day3 owner=CS/SRE (telemetry review), Day7 owner=CS/AE (renewal risk check). Keep it clipboard-friendly.

maria_csm: Draft PM one-pager (short):
1) Day0 Smoke: run the example prompts, confirm end-to-end success and that partial streaming tokens appear within ~120ms.
2) Day1 Prime: run 8-12 representative queries per major user to populate the KV cache and warm model weights.
3) Day3 Telemetry Check: verify p95 latency, error rate, and cache hit ratio (aim >35% by Day3).
4) Day7 Renewal Signal: if p95 >400ms or error rate spike >1% persist, open an escalation with your CSM.

owen_sre: Engineer snippet (single JSON block they can paste):
```json
{
  "redwood": {
    "cache": {"enabled": true, "strategy": "prefix_lru", "kv_mb": 128, "ttl_s": 150},
    "batching": {"adaptive": true, "max_batch_gpu": 48, "max_batch_cpu": 6, "target_latency_ms": 15},
    "streaming": {"chunk_tokens": 128, "window_ms": 80, "concurrent": 12},
    "fallback": {"p95_threshold_ms": 350, "fallback_model": "smaller-lowcost"}
  }
}
```

owen_sre: Quick commands for troubleshooting:
```bash
# cache hit over last 72h
redwoodctl metrics query --cust luminalabs --metric cache_hits --window 72h

# check p95 and errors
redwoodctl metrics query --cust luminalabs --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h

# streaming tail (staging)
redwoodctl logs tail --cust luminalabs --filter "stream.*error" --since 2h
```

tara_support: Add an ops playbook bullet list for fast mitigation: 1) If p95 climbs -> temporarily switch to conservative profile; 2) If cache_hit% low -> trigger prefill for top keys; 3) If many streaming gaps -> reduce chunk_tokens to 64 or increase stream_window_ms.

maria_csm: Also include a 3-question feedback snippet for Day7 to capture customer sentiment: Q1: Are answers accurate enough? (yes/no + short note); Q2: Did you observe slow responses (>500ms)? (yes/no + sample); Q3: Any streaming artifacts (truncated/incomplete outputs)? (yes/no). We'll link this to our post-onboard survey.

alex_cs: Can we include a short example email for the handoff? One line: "Attached: 1-page onboarding checklist, engineer snippet, and quick feedback form. Please run Day0 smoke with Support at <time> and populate this thread with any issues."

owen_sre: Note for private/CPU-only installs: set max_batch_cpu=6, target_latency_ms=40, and use ttl_s conservative (45) to limit head-of-line delays. I will add a CPU block in the snippet.

tara_support: Routing/escalation: CSM -> Support on-call -> SRE (pager). Add Slack channel tag #cs-helio for the first 7 days and require team readout at Day3.

alex_cs: Owners: Maria = PM one-pager + email template, Owen = engineer snippet + troubleshooting commands, Tara = run Day0 and Day3 checks and update thread. I'll coordinate the Day7 renewal checkpoint with the AE.

devops-bot: scheduled job: "prefill-top-keys" for luminalabs at 2025-06-13T08:00:00Z - status: scheduled :gear:

maria_csm: I'll upload the docs to the customer folder and paste links in the Helix handoff email. Anything else?

owen_sre: Add one more tip: enable short-lived request-level cache hints (cache_key_hint) when possible; it can lift hit ratio quickly without increasing global TTLs.

tara_support: I'm running Day0 at 09:30 PT, will update with results. :rocket:

alex_cs: Great work team — saving this thread. If anyone has edge-case notes (e.g., chatty UIs with very small tokens) drop them here before EOD. :white_check_mark:
